name: QLoRA quantized model adaptation
description: QLoRA fine-tunes low-rank adapters through a frozen quantized pretrained language model.

events.statement: Dettmers and colleagues submitted QLoRA version 1, reporting fine-tuning a 65-billion-parameter model on one 48 GB GPU. The paper also reports 33B Guanaco fine-tuning on one 24 GB consumer GPU in less than twelve hours.

evidence.supports: Gives date, authors, method and reported fine-tuning configuration.
The authors report fine-tuning their 33B Guanaco model on one consumer GPU with 24 GB memory in less than twelve hours. This concerns fine-tuning, not pretraining the underlying model.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest supported event for this scoped record, not a universal priority claim.

caveats: The 65B result concerns fine-tuning a pretrained model, not pretraining. The comparison at that scale was against 16-bit LoRA, not a demonstrated full-16-bit fine-tuning baseline. Compute and model access remain necessary.

research.note: Independent reader checked the cited original version, event claims and specified facets. The 65B/48 GB figure is an author-reported fine-tuning configuration, not pretraining cost; v1 table 4 reports the 65B BFloat16 adapter comparison. Wave 12 additions await independent review.
